about: One end-to-end encryption test vector (design section 7.3): AES-256-GCM, ciphertext = unpadded base64url of nonce(12) || sealed || tag(16), AAD = the bot's short id. Checked by the Go client (gateway/internal/client), HonkKit and :core, so a message sealed by any of them opens in the others. The nonce is a0 a1 ... ab and the key bytes are 00 01 ... 1f.

key_wrap.about: A bot's key wrapped with the group key (design, multi-device): AES-256-GCM(group_key, bot key), AAD = 'honk bot key v1|<bot id>', stored as bots.key_wrapped (80 base64url characters). Group key bytes 20 21 ... 3f, bot key bytes 40 41 ... 5f, nonce c0 c1 ... cb.
